text: The Sandiganbayan Building II is envisioned as a model for future court facilities, featuring a green building design with robust ICT infrastructure. It will have 13 floors and two basement levels, with a gross floor area of up to 24,960 square meters. The project emphasizes co-location of all court divisions to streamline operations and improve public services. The design and procurement processes, including agency-to-agency engagement for architectural design and competitive bidding for civil works, set institutional standards for judiciary infrastructure.
